time here and be just wait to visit again

Review: i have always be a fan of regional cuisine of india for their immense depth in term of culture as well a tradition and it not just the flavour on the taste bud it almost a if you could taste the history of a civilization and with the imprint nizams have leave on the city of hyderabad in every aspect it doesnt even come a a surprise a to why there be an unnumerable amount of dish in hyderabadi cuisine hyderabadi dawaat be one new joint in gachibowli area which be try to bring back the cuisine of nizams by serve dish from our very favourite hyderabadi cuisine to the best of it authenticity from slow cook raans to delicious biryani the menu for the place be full of culinary delight come to the food i go in for a dinner to sample out their menu with some of my friend where we begin the meal with a serving of a traditional yakhni shorba which be a flavourpumped version of a simple mutton shorba and an awesome start to the meal with every sip the flavour become increasingly intense with the hearty mutton tartness on the back of the tongue then come an array of appetizer both for the vegetarian as well a non vegetarian from the vegetarian one i personally love the achaari paneer tikka which have soft piece of paneer marinate in a balanced pickle spice mix which have just the right amount of tanginess to it from the non vegetarian menu there be quite a few who make to my favourite include the murgh kalmi kebab chicken leg piece marinate heavy handedly in spice and finish in tandoor to perfection gosht seekh kebab plain old mutton kebab with juicy succulent mutton mince and patrani fish fish cover in a subtle coconut base marinade wrap in cabbage and finish in tandoor from among the specialty from the area the restaurant present u with their sikandari rann which be a whole leg of lamb marinate with whole spice like clove cinnamon pepper and cashew nut finish slowly in a tandoor and serve on a bed of fried onion and garlic with some mutton shami kebab on the side each element of the dish be beautiful with the lamb take the center stage tender juicy and delicious in a similar fashion restaurant also serve specialty big platter like chelo kebab which be a persion style serving of mutton and chicken kebab on a bed of saffron rice and murg mussallam which have a whole chicken douse in a delicious ginger garlic marinade and cook till tender serve again on a bed of rice even after the rann the show wasnt over and we go in for main try out their gosht masala achari chicken and nargisi kofta all of which go really well with some hot stuffed kulchas and flaky garlic naan nargisi kofta be my favourite one which have the same delicious mutton keema wrap around boil egg and toss in a rich spicy oniontomato gravy gosht masala be a tiny bit more spicier that the kofta and have flavourful bonein mutton piece with the achari chicken the restaurant again show excellence in term of balance of flavour a the dish wasnt too tangy a preparation in most of the other restaurant turn out to be gilefirdaus and fruit salad mark the end of our meal with a sweet note both of which be less of sugar and actually quite good the service here at hyderabadi dawaat be just as good a their food the staff be warm and corteous and take care of each and every need for u diner be it a glass of water or a change of plate i be highly impressed with the kitchen which though take time to deliver the dish to the table but also put in extreme care to provide u only what be the best in a nutshell if you want to experience the true cultural heritage of hyderabad on a plate hyderabadi dawaat should absolutely be in your bucket list instagramcom
